title: Glowing paper plane
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='glow' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#aeeaff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#5bc8ff'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='wing' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#d8f6ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#9be0ff'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='fold' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#9be0ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#5bc8ff'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id='soft' x='-40%' y='-40%' width='180%' height='180%'>
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation='3' result='blur'/>
      <feMerge>
        <feMergeNode in='blur'/>
        <feMergeNode in='SourceGraphic'/>
      </feMerge>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <!-- Glow halo behind plane -->
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='40' rx='24' ry='18' fill='#2a7ab8' opacity='0.35' filter='url(#soft)'/>

  <!-- Motion trail dashes -->
  <path d='M20 58 Q30 53 40 48' stroke='#4fc3ff' stroke-width='2' fill='none' opacity='0.55' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M14 66 Q24 61 34 56' stroke='#4fc3ff' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' opacity='0.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M25 72 Q33 68 41 63' stroke='#4fc3ff' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' opacity='0.3' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Paper plane body - main triangle -->
  <polygon points='78,22 42,48 52,56' fill='url(#wing)' stroke='#7fdcff' stroke-width='0.8' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <!-- Paper plane right wing/fold -->
  <polygon points='78,22 52,56 60,70' fill='url(#glow)' stroke='#7fdcff' stroke-width='0.8' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <!-- Center crease line -->
  <line x1='78' y1='22' x2='52' y2='56' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1.2' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- Left wing shadow/fold -->
  <polygon points='42,48 52,56 48,62' fill='#7fdcff' opacity='0.6' stroke='#5bc8ff' stroke-width='0.6' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <!-- Small sparkle stars -->
  <g fill='#ffffff'>
    <circle cx='28' cy='32' r='1.5' opacity='0.9'/>
    <circle cx='88' cy='48' r='1.2' opacity='0.7'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='76' r='1' opacity='0.5'/>
    <circle cx='35' cy='72' r='1.3' opacity='0.6'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Cross sparkles -->
  <g stroke='#aeeaff' stroke-width='0.8' opacity='0.5' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <line x1='28' y1='28' x2='28' y2='36'/>
    <line x1='24' y1='32' x2='32' y2='32'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Plane nose highlight -->
  <circle cx='77' cy='23' r='2' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8' filter='url(#soft)'/>
</svg>
